min_version_code.description: Builds with a lower versionCode must update before use (force update). v1.1.0 = 10100.

latest_version_code.description: Newest published versionCode. Older builds get a dismissible 'new version' prompt (APK installs; Play installs use Play's in-app update). v1.4.0 = 10402.

update_message_te.description: Optional Telugu text for the update screen

update_message_hi.description: Optional Hindi text for the update screen

update_message_en.description: Optional English text for the update screen
